snippet.title: Dream City Profitist Version 1.660 (14 Minutes Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Dream City Profitist is an open world money focused urban role playing game. You're the new partner of Profitist Enterprise. Revive the struggling business with $20,000 seed money from Madam J on a small island, Dream City. Build a career, get to know people and find opportunities to invest.

Due to video recording, the frame rate has been locked to 30 fps. This Android version was recorded with Snapdragon 665 phone so performance should be much better without recording.

The game can be installed for free from Play Store or itch.io website:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.inspiregamesnexus.dreamcitylife
https://edykajang.itch.io/dream-city-profitist
